title: Emergency ventilation.
officialText: An emergency ventilation system shall be provided in accordance with NFPA 69 and shall be approved by the Fire Department. Ventilation calculations as listed in Annex D Ventilation Calculations of NFPA 69 shall be provided, and the gas release rate shall be approved.
